comments.value: I quite like the way it works now. I have a under powered PC and I use the safety setting to keep the game playable. Tho I don't like the way the preset options work and think they need to be redone.

The whole point of the safety system is so people with lower end PCs can play and to lower the chances of people getting crashed by crasher avatars. You could just have your friends have everything turned on for just their friends in the custom settings. Also, the safety system already tells you if some one has your avatar or any shaders/animations are blocked above their name plate. If people really didn’t want the safety feature then they could just simply turn it off themselves.

Blocking people because they have your stuff disabled seems like an over reaction. The safety system is there to prevent ear/eye rape which happens far too often in public's. If you blocked everyone who had animations disabled on you, the game would turn into a ghost town.
hey kid, i´m gonna save you time, what is your name in vrchat so I CAN BLOCK YOU xD

This is the most ridiculous suggestion I've ever read. You're seriously suggesting people get blocked because they chose to not view certain features of an avatar? If you had an avatar with obnoxious animations or anything, for example, then you would see far less people in the game overall.

More importantly, that's a useless feature because there's already a block option, and you can view whose blocked you on the website, I'm pretty sure.

The clear mental leap at play here is frankly hilarious. Lets think this through. You, being the obnoxious ass you apparently are, want to not interact with people hiding you or features of your avatar. Instead of taking an action to identify the people hiding your avatar, you instead jump to "They must be terrible, they need to be blocked!" instead of, perhaps, an indicator on the nameplate, you know, the option that isn't jumping the shark and doesn't suggest that maybe some people have features or avatars hidden for a reason, like, the obvious and most common being performance and the more dangerous such as particles and animations disabled by certain users because they can easily induce seizures. Nope, can't have nuance, they're all just terrible people and must be blocked!

This really is the most ridiculous thing I've seen on the Canny, Good job!

PS, could you please post your username here so we can all solve this problem for you by preemptively blocking you?
Please say sike....
i'm blocking you.
Yeah I miss going in Uganda

You can't interact with people who are interacting with people you have blocked. You can't read the room when you can't see most people in it. You'll interrupt a conversation that you won't even see. If you can't know when it's ok to show off stuff you'll just come off as a nuisance no matter how cool your stuff looks.

Amazing suggestion, I spend upwards of 3 hours on each of my avatars and I'd like for either everyone to see them or for me to not have to be around people who don't. Also it gets tiring manually weeding out and blocking people by using a special animation (harmless, just a small moving particle with a strange looking shader) in their face to see if they react to it or not.

Honestly, I really don't care if they hide shaders so long as it doesnt affect them seeing my hard work and animations.

As for all the dimwits below ripping this poor guy apart for wanting to enjoy VRC the way he wants, if blocking is too harsh for you snowflakes, why not implement this but just add a small icon above their nameplate instead. If they have any of your avatar hidden, icon shows up, you just don't interact with them. This wouldn't even have to be used for what OP is recommending, you could use it to not waste your time trying to show someone animations too or simply just to know if they can see you or not.

I think you all are collectively missing quite a few brain cells to have a proper and civil discussion about this. If it's a bad idea to you, for gods sake don't be an asshole over it.

I will not interact with people who cannot see my full avatar.

details: I know the new safety system is meant to keep people safe and all but there are still some people who miss the old VRChat experience where everyone could see everyone else's animations that they worked so hard on and could have spontaneous and fun encounters without having to stop and break the immersion by asking 'Ok, do you have animations turned on?'. The safety system gave people the ability to remove our hard work from their experience, give us the ability to remove them from our experience so we can enjoy VRC the way it used to be. If not, at the very least add a way to see if someone has your avatar hidden so I can block them manually. I miss the times I could go into a world with one of my avatars with a gun or something and see someone else with one and before we know it we were having a fun little gunfight or using our animations to doodle on walls without having to worry about them not seeing it and guess what I can't have that anymore.
title: Option to automatically block users who have your avatar or its features hidden
